paite: Huan kumpipa Hezekiah in huai azak in hichi ahong hi a, apuansilhte abotkek a, sai-ip puan asilh a, TOUPA' inn ah alutta hi.
heading: Kumpipa'n Isai Ngaihdan Adong / (Isa 37.1-7)

paite: Inn sung heutu Eliakim, laigelhmi Sebnah leh siampu upate sai-ip puan silh in Amoz tapa zawlnei Isai kiang ah asawl hi.
Amau akiang ah, Hezekiah in hichi in achi, "Tuni mangbatna leh salhna leh minsiatna ni ahi. Naute lah apian uh ahunta ngal a, piangsak ding in lah thahatna a-om nawnta ngal kei.

Apu Assuria kumpipa'n Pathian hing gense ding a asawl Rabshakeh thugen tengteng, TOUPA na Pathian in aza dia, athugen, TOUPA na Pathian in athu azak in ana sal kha mai ding, huaiziak in, a-om lai khosuaksunte thumsak in," achi va chi un.
Huchi in kumpipa Hezekiah sikhate Isai kiang ah ahoh uh.
Isai in akiang uah, "Na pu kiang ah huchi in gen in, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, 'Assuria kumpipa sikhate'n kei ahon gensiatnate uh, na zak thute ziak in lau mawk ke'n.
Ngai in, asung ah kha ka omsak ding a, thuthang aza ding a, ama gam ah apai nawn ding. Huchi in ama gam mahmah ah namsau puksak in ka omsak ding, achi hi,' chi in," achi hi.
Huchi in Rabshakeh akik nawn a, Assuria kumpipa'n Libna khua ana sual lai amu a; Lakish a pan apawt chih azaksa him ahi.
heading: Assuriate'n Vaulauna Dang Asawl Nawn Uh / (Isa 37.8-20)

paite: "Ngai in, nang hon dou ding in apawtta," chi a Tirhak Ethiopia gam kumpipa tungtangmi gen ana zak in Hezekiah kiang ah mite asawl hi.
Hichi in Judah kumpipa Hezekiah kiang ah na gen ding uh, "Na Pathian na muan in Jerusalem khua Assuria kumpipa khut ah piak ahi kei ding, chi in hon khem kei hen.
Ngai in, Assuria Kumpipate'n gam tengteng ahihse vek ua, atung a athilhih uh na za a; nang humbit na hi tuan dia hia?
Namte pathiante'n ka pi-le-pute'n ahihmangte uh ahumbit ua hia? Gozan, Haran, Reseph, Eden ta Thelasar a omte.
Hamath kumpipa, Arpad kumpipa, Sepharvaim khopi kumpipa, Hena kumpipa, Ivah kumpipate koi a om ahita ua? chi in,” achi hi.
Hezekiah in amisawlte khut a pan lai amu a, asim a: Hezekiah TOUPA' inn ah alut a, TOUPA ma ah huai aphalh hi.
Hezekiah TOUPA ma ah athum a, "TOUPA aw, cherubte tung a tu, Israel Pathian, nang, nang kia leitung gam tengteng Pathian na hi a; lei leh van nangmah siamsa ahi uh.
TOUPA aw, na bil na doh inla, ngai dih ve; TOUPA aw, na mit hak inla, en dih ve; Pathian hing gense dia Sennakerib in thu ahong gen ngaikhe dih ve.
TOUPA, Assuria kumpipate'n namte leh agamte uh ahihse ngei ua, apathiante uh mei ah apai uh.
Hiaite pathian ahi kei him ua, mihing khut a bawl sing leh suang ahi zaw uhi. Huaiziak in mei a pailut in ahihmang uhi.
Huaiziak in tu in TOUPA, ka Pathian uh aw, nang, nang kia TOUPA Pathian na hi chih leitung a lalgam tengteng in atheihtheihna ding un akhut a pan hon humbit in," achi hi.
Huai lai in Amoz tapa Isai in Hezekiah kiang ah, TOUPA Israel Pathian in hichi in achi: Assuria kumpipa Sennakerib siatna ding a ka kiang a na thum ka za, chih gen ding in mi asawl hi.
heading: Kumpipa Kiang A Isai Thugen / (Isa 37.21-38)

paite: Amah tungtang TOUPA'N agen hiai ahi: "Zion tanu nungak siangthou in nang hon musit in, ahon nuihsan a; Jerusalem tanu in alu hon sinkhum hi.
Kua na minsesak a, kua na gensia a? Kua tung ah ahia na aw na sansak a, na mit na hah sang? Israelte Mi Siangthoupa tung ah ahi.

Na misawlte zang in TOUPA na minsesak a, ka kangtalai tampi toh Lebanon gamgi tang sangte ka hong tungtouta hi. Huai a sidar sing sang pipite leh taksing hoih pipite ka phuk dia; alei hoihna mun gammang a tenna mun ngil pen ah ka lut ding.
Gamdang tui ka laikhia a, ka dawn zel a, ka khepek nuai ah Aigupta lui tengteng ka kangsak vek ding, na chi hi.
"Keimah in nidanglai a pan huai ka hih ahihdan bang, ma lai a pan huai ka bawl ahihdan bang na za kei a hia? Khokulh neite in chinkhawm lel bang a hihsepa ding in nang ka hon septa hi.
"Huaiziak in asung a omte'n hatna anei kei ua, alauthawng ua, ahong zahlakta uhi. Gamlak loupa bang leh loupa hing bang leh intung a loupa bang leh buh alet ma a haivuai bang ahi uhi.
"Ke'n bel na tut, na lut, na pawt leh ka tung a na hehnate ka thei hi.
Ka tung a na heh ziak leh uangtak a na pau ka bil a ahong luttouh ziak in ka nakbulh na nak ah ka bulh dia, ka sikbah na muk ah; na hong kuanna lampi mahmah ah ka hon kiksak nawn ding," chi in.
"Hiai nang a dia chiamtehna ahi ding. Tukum in buhsang na sen ding ua; kum nawn chiang in asang mah; kum thumna ah buh na tuh ding ua, at unla, grephuante bawl unla, agahte ne un.
Huchi in Judah inkote lak a khosuaksunte'n asuklam in zung akai ding ua, atoulam in agah nawn ding uhi.
Jerusalem a pan a omsunte Zion tang a pan akhosuaksunte apawtkhe ding uhi. TOUPA phatuamngaihna in hiai ahih ding," achi hi.

Huaiziak in TOUPA'N Assuria kumpipa tungtang thu huchi in agen: "Hiai khopi ah ahong tung kei ding, hiai ah leng thal akap sam kei ding, lum toh akiang ah lah ahong pai kei ding a, akhozul ah lah lei ase sang kei ding hi.
Ahong kuanna lampi ah, huai mah ah anungkik nawn dia, hiai khopi ahong tung kei ding," TOUPA'N achi.
"Kei ziak leh ka sikha David ziak in hiai khopi humbit ding in ka veng ding," chi in.
Huchi in huai zan in hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA angel akuankhia a, Assuriate giahphual ah mi nuaikhat singgiat-le-sangnga athat a; zingkhang a ahong thoh uleh, ngai in, misi luang ngen ana om maimah hi.
Huchi in Assuria kumpipa Sennakerib apawt a, akik nawn a, apai zel a, Nineveh ah a-omta hi.
Apathian Nisrok inn a amah abiak lai in hichi ahong hi a, Adrammelek leh Sarezerte'n namsau in athat ua; huchi in Ararat gam ah atailutta uh. Huchi in asik in atapa Esarhaddon alalta hi.
